semantics.tpot: full decode-stage service time per output token at stated B/worker
semantics.context_tps_panel: DeepSeek-V3.2 decode TPS normalized vs DGX over context length; not TTFT and not prefill proxy
semantics.representative_moe_layer: layer 23 TP2/TP3 latency multiplied by model MoE-layer count
semantics.dense_hbm_stream: dense decode KV, prefill KV, and prefill attention-weight streaming use TP1 dense_hbm_util=0.47; sparse-gather analytic utility remains 0.21 only for legacy sparse paths
semantics.dense_nonuniform_mapping: HACMO dense decode applies only TP1 static non-uniform mapping hop credit from method S vs B to the KV injection/NoC term; dense HBM service, matrix compute, cache hit-rate, and dynamic prefetch remain unchanged
semantics.waferllm: HACMO-side waferllm_matrix_model_hacmo_reproduction for MeshGEMV/MeshGEMM matrix stages; vLLM MoE placement and communication retained

hbm_streaming.sparse_hbm_source: supernode_sim sparse analytic/service-curve fallback for sparse/random selected-KV access

context_tps_panel.normalization: throughput_tps / vLLM+DGX throughput_tps at the same context
